description: This file defines the InstallerCompleteController class, which manages the 'installation complete' view for the OrangeHRM installer. It sets up a Vue component and updates the installation state.

classes.name: InstallerCompleteController
classes.description: Controller for handling the 'installation complete' Vue component and state management during the final installation step.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and state before rendering the installation completion screen, including setting up the Vue component and logging installation info.
